target.kernel_memory: Linux RAM ends at 0x1fefffff; 0x1ff00000..0x3fffffff is reserved by the target boot configuration

reservation.selection: The lower shared-DDR address was observed to be modified by platform services. The final 2 MiB of the target-reserved aperture retained the challenge during the bounded preflight.

protocol.ordering: ARM used an O_SYNC /dev/mem mapping and an ARM synchronization barrier; FPGA waited for DDR read data before acknowledging.

scope: This validates the actual target reservation, MiSTer DDR request path, ARM-to-FPGA visibility, FPGA-to-ARM visibility and the loaded RBF identity. It does not validate the full ABI control page, frame scanout, audio, input or the Diablo engine.
